## Human review verdict — chalbert/web-everything#1513

**Verdict:** 🚩 prevention outstanding — file the guard before accept

### Panel verdicts

| lens | weight | verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| correctness | mandatory | prevention-outstanding |

### Findings (1)

**correctness** (1)
- `scripts/lib/skill-operation-wiring.mjs:105` — COMMENT_LINE's `\*` alternative matches ordinary markdown bold-text and bullet lines, not just comment syntax, so the marker-exemption walk can silently carry an unrelated `@operation-home-ok` marker over unrelated prose and exempt a different, unrelated raw-home mention. — Reproduced directly: given `<!-- @operation-home-ok: reason for a DIFFERENT command -->\n**Note:** unrelated prose.\n**More bold prose.**\nnode scripts/verify-lane.mjs --gate=x` — findSkillsNamingUndelegatedHomes() returns 0 warnings, even though the marker's stated reason has nothing to do with the verify-lane.mjs mention three lines below it. `**bold text**` line-starts occur 169 times across the current skills-src tree (`grep -rn '^\*\*' skills-src --include='*.md' | wc -l` → 169), so the triggering pattern (a bold-led or bulleted prose line directly adjacent, no blank line) is common, not contrived. On the CURRENT tree no real false-negative fires today (verified: only two live command mentions of declared homes exist, both correctly exempted with adjacent, on-topic comment blocks), but the underlying match is structurally wrong for a markdown-only scanner — `*` denotes JSDoc-continuation only in `.mjs`/JS source, which this scan never reads; in the `.md` files it exclusively scans, `*` only ever means a bullet or the leading star of `**bold**`. Mutation probe: removing `\*` from COMMENT_LINE and rerunning `npx vitest run scripts/lib/__tests__/skill-operation-wiring.test.mjs` — all 25 tests still pass, confirming NO named test exercises or guards the `\*` branch; the file's own stated testing philosophy ("mostly negative cases, each paired with the positive that would otherwise pass it vacuously") has a gap here. _[CONFIRMED]_ _[impact if unfixed: broken]_
  - _Prevention (OWED — file it):_ Add a negative test alongside the existing 'does NOT exempt a mention far from the marker' case, using a markdown bold-led or bulleted line (no blank line) as the separator instead of blank-line-plus-prose, mirroring this file's own stated pattern of pairing every negative with the positive that would otherwise pass it vacuously.

---

**Decision:** `changes` — recorded by operator.
**Lens:** `correctness` — a SINGLE-LENS run. One `judge` step, one juror, one lens; the table above lists only the lens that judged. The other 3 panel lenses (security, simplicity, standards-conformance) did NOT run and are not reported as unjudged.
Net basis: `50fb37e61d1b16b01585e7e85e9d0c912fd8c521..36517cf2540c4483dfb393f026440ce4afb59b16` (rev `origin/lane/skill-integration-gate` at review time) — 14 net changed file(s) vs current main (#2450), not `gh pr diff`'s three-dot list.
